name: budget-fixture-isolation
goal: Title-cost and profile cases use a rank-free prepared fixture; a prepared baseline is returned only after its second verification passed

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Rank setup is global, so title and profile cases carry function.rank; baselineRepo ignores its second verification and returns an unclean repo. Original cause of the full failure stays unproven

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: test/budget-baseline-preparation.test.ts (sha d136c55e) on original verifyRepo c2ab88d0: real second verify exit 1, title missing-measurement, yet repo returned: expected ['returned'] to equal ['refused']

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: verifyRepo.ts: baselineRepo throws PreparationFailed (repo, actual outcome, record dir and failures kept) unless the second verify passes. budget-performance: title-only baseline for cases 1-2, rank baseline for case 3

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same guard d136c55e on verifyRepo 002e5f90: 2 passed. 18 expect calls, 3 names, timeouts and rank setup identical to original (work/budget-fixture/identity.txt)

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Prepare the rank baseline inside the real operation test, one title beforeAll
steps.evidence: Rank prepared inside test 3 within its 300 s bound; one 180 s title beforeAll. Setup bytes, 18 expects, 3 names, bounds identical; guard d136c55e, helper 002e5f90 unchanged (work/budget-fixture/correction)

steps.title: Track each prepared or cloned repo before its extension, verification or assertions run
steps.evidence: prepare pushes inside the extend callback before the extension; test 3 pushes its clone at once. Late catch removed. Expects, names, bounds, rank body identical; file 6a2da425 (work/budget-fixture/final-review)
